model: momentum conservation, Gus at rest 10 ft from the hatch, all the gas leaves straight backwards (generous)

sources.fart_volume: Tomlin, Lowis & Read, 'Investigation of normal flatus production in healthy volunteers', Gut 32, 665 (1991): 476-1491 ml/day (median 705), 33-125 ml per passage (median 90), median 8 passages
sources.fart_speed: no published measurement; '10 ft/s' is the popular figure (J. Dawson, Who Cut the Cheese?, 1999). Assumed; consistent with check 2
sources.suit: about 280 lb on the ground is the widely quoted figure for the NASA spacewalk suit (NASA EMU fact sheet: 113 kg = 250 lb without the SAFER jetpack; the enhanced ISS suit 319 lb); primary life support 8 h (sources give 6.5 to 8 h)
sources.safer: NASA SAFER: 3 lb (1.4 kg) of nitrogen gives about 10 ft/s (3 m/s)
sources.hair: human hair diameter 17-181 micrometres, typically 70-100 (Ley, The Physics Factbook)
